title: The cloud factory never consumes the work-type table or the classification records: RUN_WORKER_MODEL_BY_WORK_TYPE has no reader
body: mrn shipped the work-type -> model table (Go parser + env.d.ts declaration), and s45 wires the mass rule into the LOCAL orchestrator's tier derivation — but the cloud dispatch path still selects its worker model from RUN_WORKER_MODEL alone (cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts, run-workflow.ts): nothing in the control plane reads RUN_WORKER_MODEL_BY_WORK_TYPE, WorkTypeModelTable.Model, or a run branch's classification decision records. Until that is wired, the epic's "a dispatch selects its model from the recorded distribution" is true on the herdr/local path only, and a deployed factory's table is inert config.
